LESSON: READING 15.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.2: Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can you improve your reading fluency?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. recognise the use of fluency strategies in the reading process
2. apply fluency strategies while reading
3. appreciate the role of reading fluency in communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency

Teach
• Focus skill: recognise the use of fluency strategies in the reading process.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you improve your reading fluency?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
